description: Extend the existing narrative/material authority with authored early-underground sensory, wall, stair, crack, projectile, and cosmetic-damage behavior without a universal simulator or new globals

replacements.new:
<ROUTINE UNDERGROUND-PHYSICALITY-ROOM? ()
    <COND (<OR <EQUAL? ,HERE ,CELLAR ,TROLL-ROOM ,EW-PASSAGE>
               <EQUAL? ,HERE ,ROUND-ROOM ,LOUD-ROOM ,DAMP-CAVE>
               <EQUAL? ,HERE ,NS-PASSAGE ,CHASM-ROOM ,DEEP-CANYON>>
           <RTRUE>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE UNDERGROUND-WALL-DESCRIPTION ()
    <COND (<FSET? ,HERE ,RMUNGBIT>
           <TELL "Fresh pale chips and a new score interrupt the older surface. The damage is real, local, and nowhere near enough to turn the wall into a passage. " >)>
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,CELLAR>
           <TELL "The cellar masonry is cool, damp, and load-bearing in the unromantic way of walls that have spent a long time underground." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,TROLL-ROOM>
           <TELL "The stone is already marked by old bloodstains and deep axe scratches. At close range the damage looks violent, historic, and structurally unimpressed." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,EW-PASSAGE>
           <TELL "Rough stone presses close on both sides of the narrow passage. Grit sits in the seams and the air has never had much room to become weather." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,ROUND-ROOM>
           <TELL "The circular wall is solid stone, its curve broken by surviving passages and the rubble of older cave-ins." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,LOUD-ROOM>
           <TELL "The hard stone walls rise beyond the lantern's useful certainty and make excellent accomplices for every sound produced here." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,DAMP-CAVE>
           <TELL "This is natural cave surface rather than finished masonry: dark earth, stone, and moisture meeting in an irregular wall." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,NS-PASSAGE>
           <TELL "The high passage is bounded by rough stone whose upper reaches fade beyond easy inspection." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,CHASM-ROOM>
           <TELL "The stone beside the chasm is rough and cool. Beyond its edge there is considerably more absence than wall." CR>)
          (T
           <TELL "The canyon stone is cool, rough, and old enough to regard your inspection as a very recent development." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE UNDERGROUND-AIR-SMELL ()
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,CELLAR>
           <TELL "The air smells of damp masonry, old dust, and the faint stale coolness of a space shut away from daylight." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,TROLL-ROOM>
           <TELL "Stone, old iron, stale air, and the unpleasant mineral trace of old blood all compete for the same small room." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,EW-PASSAGE>
           <TELL "The narrow passage smells mostly of cool stone and settled grit." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,ROUND-ROOM>
           <TELL "Dry stone dust hangs faintly in the round room, with a chalkier note near the cave-ins." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,LOUD-ROOM>
           <TELL "The air is cool and stony, carrying a trace of moisture whose source is easier to hear than to locate." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,DAMP-CAVE>
           <TELL "Wet earth and mineral damp dominate the cave; the air tastes almost as much as it smells." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,CHASM-ROOM>
           <TELL "Cooler air works along the chasm with a mineral, slightly wet smell from somewhere below and beyond sight." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,DEEP-CANYON>
           <TELL "The air is cooler at the canyon edge and carries the damp mineral smell of water moving somewhere below." CR>)
          (T
           <TELL "The high passage smells of cold stone, dust, and air that has traveled farther underground than you have." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE UNDERGROUND-AIR-LISTEN ()
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,CELLAR>
           <TELL "The cellar gives back small sounds reluctantly: a close echo, the scrape of movement, and the occasional suggestion of air through the passages." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,TROLL-ROOM>
           <TELL "Sound is close here. A footstep returns from the stone almost immediately, with the passages supplying thinner echoes afterward." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,EW-PASSAGE>
           <TELL "The narrow passage turns every movement into a short, hard echo that runs east and west ahead of you." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,ROUND-ROOM>
           <TELL "Your smallest noise returns from several directions at once, some echoes clean and others muffled by cave-in rubble." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,LOUD-ROOM>
           <COND (<OR ,LOUD-FLAG <AND <NOT ,GATES-OPEN> ,LOW-TIDE>>
                  <TELL "The famous acoustics are still here, but the room is eerily subdued; small sounds climb the hard walls and come back thin." CR>)
                 (T
                  <TELL "The rushing roar occupies the room completely. The stone catches it, multiplies it, and throws it back until direction becomes almost meaningless." CR>)>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,DAMP-CAVE>
           <TELL "There is a faint wet ticking from somewhere in the cave and a soft movement of air near the narrow crack." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,CHASM-ROOM>
           <TELL "The chasm returns no neat echo. Sound drops away, then comes back late and thinned from distances the lantern cannot measure." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,DEEP-CANYON>
           <COND (<AND ,GATES-OPEN <NOT ,LOW-TIDE>>
                  <TELL "Water roars below, broad enough here to turn the canyon into a sounding chamber." CR>)
                 (T
                  <TELL "Flowing water can be heard below, mixed with the long hollow return of the canyon itself." CR>)>)
          (T
           <TELL "The high passage gives your movements a longer echo than its width suggests." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE UNDERGROUND-SCAR-WALL (TOOL)
    <FSET ,HERE ,RMUNGBIT>
    <TELL "The " D .TOOL " strikes stone with a hard report. A few chips jump free and a fresh pale score remains, but the wall keeps every important opinion it had about being a wall." CR>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE UNDERGROUND-PHYSICALITY-HOOK ()
    <COND (<NOT <UNDERGROUND-PHYSICALITY-ROOM?>> <RFALSE>)>
    <COND
      (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,LUNGS> <VERB? SMELL>>
       <UNDERGROUND-AIR-SMELL>
       <RTRUE>)
      (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,LUNGS> <VERB? LISTEN>>
       <UNDERGROUND-AIR-LISTEN>
       <RTRUE>)
      (<AND <OR <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,WALL> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,GRANITE-WALL>> <VERB? EXAMINE>>
       <UNDERGROUND-WALL-DESCRIPTION>
       <RTRUE>)
      (<AND <OR <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,WALL> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,GRANITE-WALL>> <VERB? RUB>>
       <COND (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,DAMP-CAVE>
              <TELL "The cave wall is cold, uneven, and damp enough to leave grit on your fingers." CR>)
             (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,CHASM-ROOM ,DEEP-CANYON>
              <TELL "The stone is cold and rough, with a faint film of moisture in its lower seams." CR>)
             (T
              <TELL "The stone is cool, dry in the raised places, and gritty where age has opened the surface." CR>)>
       <RTRUE>)
      (<AND <OR <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,WALL> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,GRANITE-WALL>> <VERB? SMELL>>
       <UNDERGROUND-AIR-SMELL>
       <RTRUE>)
      (<AND <OR <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,WALL> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,GRANITE-WALL>> <VERB? LISTEN>>
       <UNDERGROUND-AIR-LISTEN>
       <RTRUE>)
      (<AND <OR <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,WALL> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,GRANITE-WALL>> <VERB? TAKE>>
       <TELL "You find a promising grip on the wall. The wall responds by continuing to hold up the surrounding underground." CR>
       <RTRUE>)
      (<AND <OR <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,WALL> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,GRANITE-WALL>> <VERB? KICK>>
       <TELL "Your kick produces a compact stone thud and a much more personal reminder that the wall has greater mass." CR>
       <RTRUE>)
      (<AND <OR <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,WALL> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,GRANITE-WALL>>
            <VERB? CUT MUNG ATTACK>
            ,PRSI
            <MATERIAL-DESTRUCTIVE-IMPACT? ,PRSI>>
       <UNDERGROUND-SCAR-WALL ,PRSI>
       <RTRUE>)
      (<AND <VERB? THROW> ,PRSI
            <OR <EQUAL? ,PRSI ,WALL> <EQUAL? ,PRSI ,GRANITE-WALL>>
            <NOT <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,BOTTLE ,EGG ,LAMP>>>
       <COND (<MATERIAL-DESTRUCTIVE-IMPACT? ,PRSO>
              <UNDERGROUND-SCAR-WALL ,PRSO>)
             (T
              <TELL "The " D ,PRSO " strikes stone, clatters to the floor, and remains an object rather than a geological event." CR>)>
       <MOVE ,PRSO ,HERE>
       <RTRUE>)
      (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,STAIRS> <VERB? EXAMINE>>
       <COND (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,EW-PASSAGE>
              <TELL "The narrow stone stair descends from the north end of the passage toward the chasm. Its treads are worn but still decisively stairs." CR>)
             (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,LOUD-ROOM>
              <TELL "The stone stair climbs out of the reverberant room toward the canyon above; hard edges and hard walls explain much of the room's enthusiasm for echoes." CR>)
             (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,DEEP-CANYON>
              <TELL "The stair drops from the canyon edge toward the Loud Room, disappearing downward between rough stone surfaces." CR>)
             (T
              <TELL "The stair climbs back toward the East-West Passage, each worn tread close to the chasm and entirely uninterested in becoming a ladder." CR>)>
       <RTRUE>)
      (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,STAIRS> <VERB? RUB>>
       <TELL "The nearest tread is hard, cool, and smoothed slightly where countless feet have chosen the same few inches." CR>
       <RTRUE>)
      (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,STAIRS> <VERB? LISTEN>>
       <TELL "The stairs themselves are quiet; the space around them supplies the echo." CR>
       <RTRUE>)
      (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,CRACK> <VERB? EXAMINE>>
       <COND (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,DAMP-CAVE>
              <TELL "The crack narrows southward until even the game's smaller ambitions would have trouble fitting through it. Damp air moves faintly at the opening." CR>)
             (T
              <TELL "The crack opens from the south side of the chasm into the adjoining passage. It is a real opening, but not an invitation to invent a new route through the rock." CR>)>
       <RTRUE>)
      (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,CRACK> <VERB? RUB>>
       <TELL "The edge of the crack is cold, rough, and damp enough to darken the dust on your fingertips." CR>
       <RTRUE>)
      (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,CRACK> <VERB? LISTEN>>
       <COND (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,DAMP-CAVE>
              <TELL "A faint draft whispers at the crack, carrying tiny wet sounds from stone you cannot see." CR>)
             (T
              <TELL "The crack gives back a thin, directional echo from the passage beyond." CR>)>
       <RTRUE>)
      (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,CRACK> <VERB? SMELL>>
       <TELL "The opening carries cool mineral air and the smell of damp stone." CR>
       <RTRUE>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE NARRATIVE-PHYSICALITY-HOOK ()
    <COND
      (<UNDERGROUND-PHYSICALITY-HOOK> <RTRUE>)
      (<FOREST-CONSEQUENCE-HOOK> <RTRUE>)
